hook.text: This player just lost their queen. Watch what the king does next.

setup.text: This is Chaos Chess. As the game goes on, you draft powers that break the rules.

fall.text: Black runs a pawn down the board and crowns a queen. White takes it, and a rook takes White's queen. Down nine points.

regicide.text: But White drafted Regicide. The king eats a knight, and the dead queen comes back.

horde.text: Next up, Knight Horde. Two free knights, out of thin air.

knook.text: And the finish: the Knook. A knight that moves like a rook. All the way up the file, and the king falls.

outro.text: That was a real game, straight from the feed. Now draft your own, at chaos dot firechess dot com.
